candidates.raw_title: Alteogen Enters Option and License Agreement with Novartis for Hybrozyme-Enabled SC Products
candidates.gate_e: Directly answers the tracker question: values Alteogen's ALT-B4/Hybrozyme SC-enabling enzyme at up to $3.22B, a new major licensee.
candidates.reject_reason: Out of window (published 2026-09-02, window starts 2026-09-07); already logged as deal_id alteogen_novartis_2026-09 in a prior run.
Out of window; already logged as deal_id prestige_idc224_patent_2026-04.

candidates.raw_title: Altruist Biologics launches Altru-CON high-concentration formulation platform
candidates.gate_e: A new, previously untracked high-concentration formulation platform (Innovent Biologics subsidiary) directly bears on the competitive landscape of who can concentrate biologics for SC delivery.
candidates.reject_reason: Out of window (published 2026-03-04, ~6 months before window start). New untracked competitor - flagged for future consideration, not logged this run per window rule.

candidates.raw_title: Amicogen secures 2 domestic patents for next-generation human hyaluronidase for SC formulation
candidates.gate_e: A new, non-PH20/non-ALT-B4 human hyaluronidase competitor to ENHANZE and Hybrozyme aimed squarely at the SC concentration-enabling enzyme market.
candidates.reject_reason: Out of window (patent decision 2026-07-14, article 2026-07-21; ~7 weeks before window start). New untracked competitor - flagged for future consideration.

candidates.raw_title: Korea MFDS approves Keytruda SC (pembrolizumab + berahyaluronidase alfa/ALT-B4)
candidates.gate_e: First Korea-market regulatory approval of an ALT-B4-enabled product, directly validating Alteogen's Hybrozyme platform commercially.
candidates.reject_reason: Out of window (~3.5 months before window start). Not currently reflected as its own deal row under alt-b4_hybrozyme - worth a possible backfill in a future run, but out of scope for this window.

candidates.raw_title: Shanghai Bao Pharmaceuticals (Baopharma) wins NMPA approval for KJ017 recombinant human hyaluronidase
candidates.gate_e: First and only recombinant human hyaluronidase approved for marketing in China - a new direct competitor to ENHANZE/rHuPH20 and ALT-B4/Hybrozyme for large-volume SC infusion.
candidates.reject_reason: Out of window (NMPA approval 2026-03-31, announced 2026-04-08; ~5 months before window start). Significant new untracked competitor - recommend adding as a technology in a future run.

candidates.raw_title: Halozyme sues Merck over subcutaneous Keytruda (ALT-B4); FDA approves Keytruda Qlex
candidates.gate_e: Central IP conflict between the two leading SC-enabling hyaluronidase platforms tracked (ENHANZE vs ALT-B4/Hybrozyme) directly answers the competitive question.
candidates.reject_reason: Out of window by over a year (FDA approval Sept 19 2025; German PI Dec 2025; US suit filed April 2025). Litigation status and Keytruda Qlex approval not currently reflected in alt-b4_hybrozyme or enhanze tech rows - flagged for a possible future correction/addition, out of scope this window.
